definition_zh: 梳子；梳理；仔细搜寻
definition_en: a tool with teeth for tidying hair, to tidy hair with such a tool, or to search a place very carefully
core_image: 一把齿密的小梳子从发根滑到发梢
scene: 出门前她对着镜子把头发理顺。 He combed his hair and straightened his tie.
sceneCN: 这里 comb 指「梳理」（第 2 个义项：用梳子整理头发）；句意是他梳好头发，拉直了领带。

derivatives.zh: 梳理；搜查
梳毛工；梳毛机
蜂巢
未梳理的

senses.title: A tool for hair
senses.definition: a flat tool with a row of teeth used to tidy hair
senses.definitionCN: 有一排齿、用来理顺头发的扁平工具
senses.example: She keeps a small comb in her pocket.
senses.exampleCN: 她在口袋里放着一把小梳子。
senses.why: The old word named a toothed tool long before it named the act.
senses.whyCN: 这个古老的词先指带齿的工具，很久以后才指动作。

senses.title: To tidy hair
senses.definition: to tidy your hair with a comb
senses.definitionCN: 用梳子把头发理顺
senses.example: He combed his hair before the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 面试前他梳了梳头发。
senses.why: The tool became a verb: to work a comb through hair.
senses.whyCN: 工具变成动词：把梳子穿过头发。

senses.title: To search very carefully
senses.definition: to search a place or a set of things thoroughly
senses.definitionCN: 彻底搜遍一个地方或一批东西
senses.example: Police combed the field for clues.
senses.exampleCN: 警察仔细搜查了那片田野寻找线索。
senses.why: A comb's teeth pass through every strand, and a search passes through every corner.
senses.whyCN: 梳齿穿过每根发丝，搜查也穿过每个角落。

intro.en: Comb is a native Germanic word; Old English camb named a toothed tool.
intro.cn: comb 是日耳曼语本族词，古英语 camb 指带齿的工具。

items.en: An old root described a toothed object.
items.cn: 一个古老词根描述带齿的物件。

items.en: Camb named the tool for hair and for weaving.
items.cn: camb 指梳理与织造用的工具。

items.en: The final b was once pronounced, then grew silent.
items.cn: 词尾 b 先发音，后来变得不发音。

items.en: The noun turned into a verb meaning to tidy hair.
items.cn: 名词转为动词，意为梳理头发。

items.en: The verb extended to searching every corner.
items.cn: 动词又扩展到搜遍每个角落。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words near in spelling, while the meaning group names tools and thorough actions.
note.cn: 形近组收的是拼写相近的短词，近义组列出梳理工具与彻底的动作。

entries.definition: to move toward the speaker or a place
a shape with a round base and a point
entries.definitionCN: 底面为圆、顶端带尖的形状

entries.definition: a grave built of stone
a tool with soft hairs used for tidying
to free hair or thread from knots
entries.definitionCN: 把头发或线从结中解开

entries.definition: to look through a place carefully

normalIntro.en: These hooks run a comb through hair, then stretch the same motion across a whole field.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子让梳子穿过头发，再把同一个动作拉到整片田野上。

normal.en: Comb keeps a silent b, a small trap in spelling.
normal.cn: comb 末尾的 b 不发音，是拼写上的小陷阱。

normal.en: The teeth of a comb explain both tidying and searching.
normal.cn: 梳齿既能说明整理，也能说明搜查。

normal.en: Honeycomb keeps the image of many small cells in a row.
normal.cn: honeycomb 保留了排成一行行小格的形象。

normal.en: Comb your hair is a daily act, comb a field is a police act.
normal.cn: 梳头是日常动作，搜查田野是警察的动作。

normal.en: The tool came first, the verb came later.
normal.cn: 先有工具，后有动词。

abstract.en: Picture a small comb sliding from the forehead to the neck.
abstract.cn: 想象一把小梳子从前额滑到颈后。

abstract.en: Picture many hands parting tall grass in a slow line.
abstract.cn: 想象许多只手排成一行，慢慢拨开高草。

abstract.en: Picture a honeycomb full of neat six-sided cells.
abstract.cn: 想象一只蜂巢，满是整齐的六角小格。

examples.en: She always carries a comb in her bag.
examples.cn: 她包里总带着一把梳子。

examples.en: He combed his hair back with water.
examples.cn: 他用水把头发向后梳。

examples.en: Rescuers combed the ruins for survivors.
examples.cn: 救援人员在废墟中仔细搜寻生还者。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 comb 记成齿密的小梳子：一梳理顺头发，一梳搜遍角落。

root: 日耳曼语本族词，古英语作 camb，本指带齿的梳理工具，后转为梳理与彻底搜查的动作。

sensesIntro.en: A toothed tool first, then the act of tidying, and finally the act of searching every corner.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是带齿的工具，再是整理的动作，最后是搜遍每个角落。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of teeth passing through tangled strands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排齿穿过缠结的细丝。

branches.en: The object sense is the oldest in English.
branches.cn: 物件义是英语中最古老的。

branches.en: Tidying is the tool used on hair.
branches.cn: 整理就是把这个工具用在头发上。

branches.en: Searching stretches the same motion over a whole area.
branches.cn: 搜查把同一个动作铺展到整片区域。

branches.en: The noun and the verb share one picture of teeth in hair.
branches.cn: 名词与动词共享齿穿过头发的同一幅画面。

branches.en: Both actions pass through every part without skipping.
branches.cn: 两个动作都逐处穿过，绝不跳过。

intro.en: Comb takes -ing and -er, and joins honey and fine-toothed to build new nouns.
intro.cn: comb 可接 -ing 与 -er，并与 honey、fine-toothed 组合成新名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; comb belongs to the older Germanic layer of English.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根，comb 属于英语更古老的日耳曼语层。

items.meaning: more than one comb, or he tidies his hair
tidied with a comb or searched thoroughly
the act of tidying or searching
a person or machine that combs fibres
items.example: The comber prepares wool for spinning.
items.exampleCN: 梳毛机为纺线准备羊毛。

items.meaning: the wax structure made by bees
items.example: The honeycomb hung from a branch.

items.meaning: a comb with teeth set close together
items.example: A fine-toothed comb catches small eggs.

items.meaning: hair combed across a bare patch
items.example: His comb-over moved in the wind.
items.exampleCN: 他横梳的头发被风吹动。

definition_zh: 麻烦的；令人烦恼的；棘手的；讨厌的
definition_en: causing trouble, difficulty, or annoyance
core_image: 一扇门关不严，风一吹就咯咯响，怎么修都不服帖
scene: 课堂上，后排两个学生一直传纸条，老师几次停下来看他们。 The troublesome noise from the pipes kept the whole floor awake.
sceneCN: 这里 troublesome 是「令人烦恼的」（第 1 个义项：带来麻烦、令人不快）；句意为管道传来的恼人噪声让整层楼都睡不着。关不严的门反复作响正是这个词的画面。

pos.zh: 形容词：麻烦的；令人烦恼的

derivatives.zh: 形容词加 -ly 构成副词，义为「麻烦地；令人烦恼地」
形容词加 -ness 构成名词，义为「麻烦；棘手」
去掉 -some 的基础名词，义为「麻烦」

senses.title: Causing annoyance
senses.definition: causing annoyance or difficulty, especially again and again
senses.definitionCN: 反复带来烦恼或困难
senses.example: The troublesome tap drips all night.
senses.exampleCN: 那个讨厌的水龙头滴了一整夜。
senses.why: The suffix -some means causing, so the word says plainly that trouble is being caused.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -some 意为「引起」，所以这个词直说：麻烦正在被引起。

senses.title: Hard to deal with
senses.definition: difficult to handle, solve, or control
senses.definitionCN: 难以处理、解决或控制的
senses.example: The border issue is a troublesome one.
senses.exampleCN: 边境问题是个棘手的问题。
senses.why: A problem earns the suffix when every solution costs more than it seems worth.
senses.whyCN: 一道难题一旦每个解法都代价高过所值，就配上了这个词尾。

senses.title: Behaving badly
senses.definition: of a person, often behaving badly and causing work for others
senses.definitionCN: 指人常常胡闹、给别人添事
senses.example: He was a troublesome pupil in his first year.
senses.exampleCN: 他第一年是个难管的学生。
senses.why: A person who keeps causing work is someone who keeps causing trouble, so -some fits again.
senses.whyCN: 常给人添活的人就是常惹麻烦的人，所以 -some 依然合适。

intro.en: The word is English through and through: the noun trouble plus the suffix -some, causing.
intro.cn: 这个词彻头彻尾是英语自造：名词 trouble 加上意为「引起」的后缀 -some。

items.en: Troubler supplies the base noun and verb, meaning to disturb.
items.cn: 古法语 troubler 提供了基础名词与动词，意为扰乱。

items.en: The noun trouble is in use by the thirteenth century.
items.cn: 名词 trouble 在十三世纪已在使用。

items.en: The suffix -some forms adjectives from nouns, as in handsome and tiresome.
items.cn: 后缀 -some 由名词构成形容词，如 handsome 与 tiresome。

items.en: Troublesome is recorded from the sixteenth century with the sense of causing trouble.
items.cn: troublesome 从十六世纪起有记录，意为引起麻烦。

items.en: It now covers things, times, and people that are hard to manage.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖难对付的事物、时期与人。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers other -some adjectives, while the near-meaning group names other words for annoying things.
note.cn: 形近组汇集其他 -some 形容词，近义组列出其他表示恼人的词。

entries.definition: a problem or difficulty
making you feel tired and bored
causing slight annoyance
good looking; the suffix is shared, the meaning differs
entries.definitionCN: 英俊的；只是词尾相同，意思不同

entries.definition: making you feel slightly angry
causing difficulty to solve
hard to deal with
causing no damage or trouble

normalIntro.en: Trouble plus -some, and -some always means causing.
normalIntro.cn: trouble 加 -some，而 -some 总是表示「引起」。

normal.en: Tiresome, bothersome, and troublesome share one suffix.
normal.cn: tiresome、bothersome、troublesome 共用同一个词尾。

normal.en: The stress falls on the first syllable: TROUB-lesome.
normal.cn: 重音在第一音节：TROUB-lesome。

normal.en: The adverb adds -ly and the noun adds -ness.
normal.cn: 副词加 -ly，名词加 -ness。

normal.en: The word can describe things, times, and people alike.
normal.cn: 这个词既可形容事物、时期，也可形容人。

normal.en: Its base noun takes no article when used in the abstract.
normal.cn: 作抽象用法时，它的基础名词不带冠词。

abstract.en: Picture a door that will not shut properly.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇怎么也关不严的门。

abstract.en: Hear it rattle whenever the wind comes past.
abstract.cn: 听风一过就咯咯作响。

abstract.en: Feel how that sound keeps nagging at the ear.
abstract.cn: 体会那声音怎样一直磨着耳朵。

examples.en: The cough proved more troublesome than the fever.
examples.cn: 咳嗽比发烧更让人难受。

examples.en: They found the tax rules particularly troublesome.
examples.cn: 他们发现税务规定特别棘手。

examples.en: A troublesome cough kept him off work for a week.
examples.cn: 一场讨厌的咳嗽让他一周没能上班。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿了不松」——鞋穿了不松，却磨脚磨得烦人。

root: trouble（拉丁语 turba「骚动」经古法语）+ 后缀 -some（引起……的），英语自造词

sensesIntro.en: The suffix links all three senses: whatever or whoever keeps causing trouble.
sensesIntro.cn: 词尾把三个义项串起来：凡是不停引起麻烦的东西或人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door that will not shut and rattles in the wind.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇关不严的门，风里咯咯作响。

branches.en: The annoyance sense, where the trouble is a sound or a fault.
branches.cn: 烦人义：麻烦是声音或毛病。

branches.en: The difficult sense, where the trouble is a problem.
branches.cn: 棘手义：麻烦是一道难题。

branches.en: The personal sense, where the trouble is a person.
branches.cn: 人事义：麻烦来自一个人。

branches.en: The mixture, where a fault becomes a problem for everyone.
branches.cn: 混合义：小毛病成了大家的难题。

branches.en: The plain annoyance sense again, where the rattle goes on.
branches.cn: 再回烦人义：那响声还在继续。

intro.en: The word is a native compound, built from a French noun and an English suffix.
intro.cn: 这个词是本土合成，由一个法语名词加一个英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: The base trouble goes back to Latin turba, so the Latin list gives that root.
latinIntro.cn: 它的基础词 trouble 上溯到拉丁语 turba，故拉丁同源词列出这个词根。

items.exampleCN: 那是一场令人厌烦的等待。

items.example: He was a handsome young man.

definition_en: a police officer in informal speech, or to receive something unpleasant
core_image: 街角一个穿制服的身影，帽檐压得很低
scene: 夜里巷口有人吹了声口哨，穿制服的人转过身来。 A cop stopped us at the corner and asked for our names.

root: 来自古英语 hype，是日耳曼语中表示髋部的固有词，与德语 Hüfte 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Hip means the body joint at the side of the waist, or the matching part of clothing.
sensesIntro.cn: hip 指腰侧的身体关节，或衣服相对应的臀围部分。

core.en: The joint where the leg joins the body.
core.cn: 腿与身体相连的关节。

branches.en: He fell off the bike and hurt his hip.
branches.cn: 他从自行车上摔下来，伤了髋部。

branches.en: The trousers are tight around the hips.
branches.cn: 这条裤子臀围处很紧。

branches.en: Clothing is cut to follow the body's hip.
branches.cn: 衣服的裁剪要顺着身体的髋部。

branches.en: The dancer moved her hips slowly.
branches.cn: 舞者慢慢地摆动髋部。

branches.en: The dress has a loose hip.
branches.cn: 这条裙子臀围处比较宽松。

intro.en: Hip appears in hipbone and hip-hop.
intro.cn: hip 出现在 hipbone 和 hip-hop 等词中。

latinIntro.en: Hip is Germanic in origin, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: hip 源自日耳曼语，而不是拉丁语。

items.meaning: a member of a youth movement

items.exampleCN: 这种剪裁适合臀部丰满的身材。

items.example: The hipster rode a fixed-gear bike.
items.exampleCN: 那个潮人骑着一辆死飞自行车。

items.meaning: having hips of a stated kind
